title.zh: 将东明多洛省纳万市镇圣奥古斯丁小学的名称变更为Santiago Garong纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the San Agustin Elementary School in the Municipality of Naujan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, to Santiago Garong Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the San Agustin Elementary School in the Municipality of Naujan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, to Santiago Garong Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học San Agustin tại Thị trấn Naujan, Tỉnh Oriental Mindoro thành Santiago Garong Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Agustin ในเทศบาล Naujan, จังหวัด Oriental Mindoro เป็น Santiago Garong Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar San Agustin di Kotamadya Naujan, Provinsi Oriental Mindoro menjadi Santiago Garong Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah San Agustin di Perbandaran Naujan, Wilayah Oriental Mindoro menjadi Santiago Garong Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1103_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the San Agustin Elementary School in the municipality of Naujan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, is changed to Santiago Garong Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1954.
